text: I'm a foster carer, ringing about a boy of 7 in my care. He's had a temperature since yesterday, 40°C tonight. In between his calpol and ibuprofen doses he's been playing, drinking and chatting away. But his skin has gone pale and patchy, sort of mottled, and his lips look a bit bluish to me. There's no rash on him at all, I've checked all over. I wanted to report that and get advice on what to do next.
